title: Finding policy
description: Which measured values count as a finding, under which framework clause, at which severity. Not a pipeline configuration: which analyzers run and with which pins is recorded in manifest.run. The policy's id and version go in run.policy_version and its content hash in run.pins so findings are reproducible.

framework.description: Framework findings are filed under, e.g. corpuscle-default; framework mapping in Phase 2 adds others.

evidence_limit.description: Maximum doc_hashes attached as evidence per finding (default 50).

rule_id.description: Becomes finding_id. Stable across policy versions.

evidence_flag.description: Record flag whose bearers are attached as evidence when the rule flags or fails.
